name: swarm
description: Run large agent jobs with little supervision. brief: interview the user until they have decided what they want, then freeze it as a written brief an unattended run can build against. go: carry a frozen brief to a checked result inside the approved cap, planning each piece around who or what will say it is right, and report with the user's decisions last. loop: an unattended loop gated by a check the agent cannot touch, with the swarm-loop supervisor on PATH. payoff: cost per accepted result by kind of work.
